excerpt: Spotahome is a Madrid-based platform for renting furnished flats and rooms for a month or more, fully online, with verified landlords and payment protections. Founded in 2014.
content:
Spotahome is an online platform for mid- to long-term rentals: furnished apartments, studios, rooms in shared flats and student residences that you rent by the month. It is built for people who need a home in another city without visiting first, such as students, interns and professionals relocating for work. Listings are booked online, and Spotahome sits between tenant and landlord to handle payment and some protections. Its homepage says it serves more than 180,000 tenants with more than 110,000 properties in over 800 cities.

Spotahome's "how it works" page explains the booking flow. You request a property, and you are only charged if the landlord confirms. Your first month's rent is passed to the landlord only 48 hours after you move in, and you have 24 hours after moving in to report a property that does not match its listing. Cancellation refunds depend on timing: a full refund 60 or more days before move-in, 50% at 30 to 59 days, and nothing within 29 days. The Spotahome fee itself is non-refundable once a booking is confirmed. The homepage also says that if a landlord cancels at the last minute, Spotahome will pay for a hotel while it finds an alternative, and that many listings are deposit-free.

The company is based in Madrid and was founded in 2014. Online Marketplaces reported in March 2023 that it had raised almost €100 million since then but had gone through several rounds of layoffs, including cutting up to 80% of jobs during the pandemic. CEO Alejandro Artacho told Spanish newspaper Expansión that losses would fall to €2 million in 2023 from €6 million in 2022 and that he expected the company to be fully profitable in 2024.

This profile draws on Spotahome's own pages and published reporting. We have not used the service, and nothing here is paid placement.
